evals.prompt: I just cloned my skill repo onto a new build server. Which skill sets should I install here?
evals.expected_output: Runs install.sh list, summarises sets with install state and recommendation, and asks before installing.
expectations: Reports for each set whether it is recommended on this machine
Asks the user which sets to install before running install
Does not create symlinks by hand

evals.prompt: remove the bmc skills from this laptop, I don't build firmware here
evals.expected_output: Uninstalls the bmc set via install.sh and checks status.
expectations: Uses install.sh uninstall bmc rather than rm on ~/.claude/skills entries
Does not touch skills from other sets

evals.prompt: install the engineering set — it says tdd was SKIPPED because ~/.claude/skills/tdd already exists, just fix it
evals.expected_output: Shows the conflicting entry and asks before removing it.
expectations: Inspects what ~/.claude/skills/tdd currently is (symlink target or directory)
Asks the user before removing or replacing the existing entry
Re-runs install.sh install engineering after the conflict is resolved
